correctness.rationale: The normalized arclength moments E cos=0, E sin=2/π, E cos²=1/2, Var sin=1/2-4/π² yield the exact symmetric reproducing kernel K=1+2cosθcosφ+((sinθ-m)(sinφ-m))/v. Symmetry yields equal L1 and L∞ norms, each equal to max_θ ∫|K|dφ/π. Reflecting φ about π/2 reduces F(θ) to a max over |1+(t-m)(s-m)/v| and 2√(1-t²)√(1-s²), t=sinθ. For 0≤t≤1/3 the positive branch on s≤m and the negative/b branch on s>m are nonincreasing; the positive s>m branch is dominated by b by concavity, with strict decrease for t>0. For 1/3≤t≤1 the Cauchy bound F²≤K(θ,θ), a strictly convex quadratic with both endpoint values <4, gives F<2, whereas an exact rational interval witness proves F(0)>2. Thus only θ=0,π maximize. At θ=0, the two interior kernel sign roots φ±=π-arctan(2π/D)±arccos(π²/R) allow exact integration to the displayed 2.048099271479... constant, attained by sign(K(0,·)). Independent 45-digit quadrature reproduced the algebraic formula and checked five interior evaluations. Full-circle finite cyclic Fourier projection is not the same Gram kernel.
